notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/421ecc95bcb0f8c06d567463d3a4bcc6793b9dc1.png[/img]

Welcome back, curious minds!

[u][b]The moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived![/b][/u]
I’m delighted to announce that Sani Yang’s Laboratory will officially open its doors on:

🗓️ September 29th (PDT)

You’ve been following our progress since the early days—through trials, demos, and research breakthroughs. Thanks to your support, the laboratory is now ready to welcome you properly. And I, for one, can’t wait to see you step inside.

Since our last encounter, my team and I have been refining every detail, adjusting every mechanism, and ensuring that your experience will be nothing short of unforgettable. Every corner of this laboratory has been prepared with care… just for you.

So, what comes next?
Mark the date. Ready your curiosity. And prepare to embark on this new chapter with us. The laboratory doors will swing wide open—and beyond them, discoveries await.

I’ll see you on September 29th. The laboratory is waiting… and so am I.

With anticipation,
— Professor Sani Yang

notes.title: First Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/9c076ffd40b492d895072c432eed550a2e7683ba.png[/img]

Hello again, curious minds!
[u][b]I've been hard at work making some important improvements to the lab![/b][/u]

Here's what I've fine-tuned for you:

🔧 [b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dimmed the lab lighting - Your eyes will thank you during those long research sessions!
[*] Fixed character display issues - Now all languages show their characters correctly
[*] Polished English text - Much smoother reading experience
[*] Completely refreshed Simplified Chinese - A thorough overhaul for better clarity
[/list]

Special thanks go to [b]L.C. and ⑨(ᗜˬᗜ)BAKA[/b] for their valuable feedback! Community input like yours helps make the lab a better place for everyone.

These updates should make your time in the laboratory much more comfortable. Keep exploring, and don't hesitate to share your thoughts—I'm always listening!

Happy researching~!
